novelty_flags.label: prop:selected-bow-witness
novelty_flags.one_line: The only displayed denominator lock is forced by making the conditioned-on variable C_b isolated, so D=P(C_b=1|do(X_b),S_b=1)=1/2 independently of the varying selected mechanism and does not test the normalization obstruction the converse must overcome.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: ass:binary-observed / thm:complete-characterization
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The claimed boundary is restricted to the full-support binary observed subclass; no finite-alphabet extension is claimed.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Conditional completeness only for M_bin^+(P), not Chen--Mooij's full positive-discrete domain.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 32–33, Theorems 4.14–4.15; p. 47, Appendix B.4 Algorithm 3
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorems 4.14–4.15 prove sIDP soundness and completeness for unconditional selected kernels on input-free COPAGs; Appendix B.4 gives sCIDP for conditional effects but states no corresponding completeness theorem.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 1, abstract and Table 1; p. 8, Remark 5.3; p. 9, Conclusion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies latent-variable S-ID for P_X(Y|S=1) from P(V|S=1), supplies a sound algorithm, and explicitly conjectures its completeness.
The fixed-graph semi-Markovian paper reduces conditional effects P_x(y|z) to joint interventional identification and states a complete graphical criterion and algorithm.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the isolated C_b regression case with a selected graph in which C is genuinely postintervention-informative, and give an exact positive rational pair whose equal D is achieved by a nontrivial cancellation rather than C-independence.

State and prove a reusable lock lemma identifying primitive graph/mechanism conditions under which the tangent nullspace contains a direction preserving both P_obs and D; use it to delimit when the residual-forest handle can plausibly work.
Retain the bow example only as a baseline sanity test and label it explicitly as a vacuous-denominator regression case, separate from the claimed evidence for conditional-completeness extraction.

recommended_next_step: Revise the witness layer first: construct a nontrivial denominator-locked selected conditional example, then reassess whether the residual-forest extraction handle has credible generic support.
